name: lazyninja.co
description: lazyninja.co: static Astro site + small Express API for LazyNinja LLC

scripts.bootstrap: npm ci && npm ci --prefix site && npm ci --prefix api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix site && npm run typecheck --prefix api
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix site && npm run build --prefix api
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run check:htaccess && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
